landing.title: Turn your habits and goals into an RPG quest
landing.subtitle: Ignite turns self-improvement into a game. Habits become Daily Rituals, a big goal becomes an Epic Quest of small steps, and every step earns XP, ranks and Sparks. Public, with people who cheer you on, or completely private.
landing.heroImageAlt: A glowing crystal artifact representing your progress in Ignite

proof.pioneers: Be one of the first heroes

why.title: It was never about willpower
why.lead: Ignite grew out of five things I kept noticing while studying motivation, goal-setting and discipline — and out of what actually helps.

motivation.title: Laziness is a myth
motivation.problem: There are no lazy people, only a shortage of motivation.
motivation.solution: XP, ranks and Sparks give every small action an immediate, visible payoff.

social.title: Social capital works
social.problem: A public promise pulls far harder than a quiet decision to start on Monday.
social.solution: Make a mission public and your progress becomes visible — and your effort gets noticed.

together.title: Company makes it lighter
together.problem: Difficult habits are far easier to build among people doing the same thing than alone.
together.solution: Join anyone's public ritual and share the wins, the slumps and the encouragement.

privacy.title: Privacy is a strength too
privacy.problem: For many people, feeling watched and fearing judgement only adds stress.
privacy.solution: Any mission can be fully private. Nobody sees it. No feed, no comparison.

scale.title: Scale is the scary part
scale.problem: Huge goals collapse because they were never broken into small, obvious steps.
scale.solution: An Epic Quest is a chain of small steps, and each one already counts as a win.

missions.title: Pick the shape of your goal
missions.lead: Either kind can be public or private. You decide who gets to see it.

ritual.title: Daily Ritual
ritual.tagline: For habits you want to make automatic
ritual.description: Choose how long it runs and show up every day — or every other day. Every check-in extends your streak.
ritual.example4: Start the day with a glass of water
ritual.social: Anyone can join a public ritual, so you compare notes and keep each other going.

quest.title: Epic Quest
quest.tagline: For the one big goal you keep postponing
quest.description: Set the finish line, then split the road to it into as many small steps as you need. Each step closes the distance.
quest.example2: Train for and run a marathon
quest.social: A quest is personal, so nobody joins it — but a public quest can be followed and cheered on.
quest.reward: Every quest has a day of triumph and a reward you promise yourself for finishing.

steps.title: Plus a place for the small stuff
steps.description: Things too small for a ritual and too one-off for a quest — book the dentist, pick up a parcel. Daily Steps for today and tomorrow, and they earn XP too.

rewards.title: Every step pays out
rewards.lead: Progress you can see is progress you keep.

xp.title: Experience
xp.text: Missions and daily steps award XP. XP is what moves your hero up.

ranks.title: Ranks
ranks.text: Collect enough experience and you climb to the next rank.

sparks.title: Sparks
sparks.text: The in-app currency you earn simply for not giving up.

freeze.title: Streak freeze
freeze.text: Spend Sparks to freeze a streak, keep a run unbroken, or extend a ritual you did not want to end.

privacy.title: Public when it helps. Private when it doesn't.
privacy.publicText: Visible to others. People can join your rituals, follow your quests, comment and cheer you on. Accountability that actually bites.
privacy.privateText: Yours alone. No audience, no comparison, no pressure — just you and the streak.

screens.title: What you will actually be looking at
screens.lead: Your day, your missions and your progress on a single screen.
screens.alt: The Ignite dashboard showing active missions and daily steps

pwa.title: On your home screen in ten seconds
pwa.text: Ignite is a PWA, so there is nothing to download and nothing to update. Add it from the browser and it behaves like a normal app on both Android and iOS. Notifications stay off until you switch them on yourself.
pwa.pointNotifications: Notifications only if you enable them
pwa.alt: Ignite running full screen on a phone

founder.title: Why I built this
founder.paragraph1: For years I wanted to put my two backgrounds — psychology and programming — into a single project. I spent a long time watching how the people around me actually behave when they try to change something about themselves. Ignite is what came out of it.
founder.paragraph2: It is in open beta right now, and your feedback matters more to me than anything else. Try it, tell me what broke, what felt awkward, and what is missing.

faq.title: Straight answers
faq.freeAnswer: Yes. Ignite is in open beta and free to use.
faq.downloadQuestion: Do I have to install anything?
faq.downloadAnswer: No. It is a web app — open it in your browser, and add it to your home screen if you want it one tap away.
faq.privacyQuestion: Will other people see my goals?
faq.privacyAnswer: Only if you want them to. Every mission is either public or private, and private means nobody but you can see it.
faq.aloneQuestion: Can I use it completely alone?
faq.aloneAnswer: Absolutely. Joining, commenting and following are all optional. Plenty of people run only private missions and never touch the social side.
faq.failQuestion: What if I miss a day?
faq.failAnswer: Nothing is lost. You can spend Sparks to freeze your streak, and a missed day never deletes your progress.
